title: Nutty Light Indian Chicken Frittata
description: A flavorful and nutritious breakfast dish featuring caramelized onions, crunchy almonds, and spicy green chillies.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt 1 tbsp of butter over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally (10-12 minutes).
Add the chopped green chillies and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chicken and cook until browned and cooked through (5-6 minutes).
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, almond meal, garam masala, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked chicken and onion mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat the remaining 1 tbsp of butter in a 9-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set (2-3 minutes).
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake until the frittata is set and golden brown (10-12 minutes).
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese (if using).
Return the skillet to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly (2-3 minutes).
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
